name: useWifi7MLO
summary: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) Multi-Link Operation and 320 MHz channel telemetry.
plain: Inspects affiliated Wi-Fi 7 radio links operating simultaneously across 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, and 6 GHz spectrum, reporting bonded link speeds and channel bandwidths.
description: Reads Multi-Link Operation (MLO) telemetry introduced in Android 14+ (API 34+) for 802.11be Wi-Fi 7 routers and modems. Surfaces the array of active affiliated links, their respective channel widths (including ultra-wide 320 MHz channels on 6 GHz), per-link transmit and receive speeds, and calculates combined aggregate throughput. Reports inactive on Wi-Fi 6 or earlier.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the device hardware and platform support Wi-Fi 7 MLO querying.

returns.name: isMloActive
returns.desc: Whether multiple simultaneous radio links are currently bonded.

returns.name: links
returns.desc: Array of affiliated radio links with frequency band, channel width, RSSI, and link speeds.

returns.name: aggregateSpeedMbps
returns.desc: Combined theoretical PHY throughput across all bonded links in Mbps, or null.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if Wi-Fi link inspection failed.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Queries the Wi-Fi subsystem for updated link state.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Requests an updated reading of affiliated Wi-Fi 7 links.

agentNote: Available on Android 14+ (API 34+) devices with Wi-Fi 7 hardware (Google Pixel 8/9/10/11).
